nodes.description: Ownable._owner: privileged owner address controlling mint, burn, admin and token recovery
ERC20._balances: mapping of account balances
ERC20._allowances: nested mapping of spender allowances
ERC20._totalSupply: total minted token supply
Claimable.pendingOwner: two-step ownership transfer nominee
ERC20WithPermit.nonces: per-holder signature nonce replay protection
ERC20WithPermit.DOMAIN_SEPARATOR: EIP-712 domain separator
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT: EIP-1967 implementation storage slot
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.ADMIN_SLOT: EIP-1967 admin storage slot
CanReclaimTokens.recoverableTokensBlacklist: tokens that owners may not reclaim
Initializable.initialized: guards one-time initializer execution
Initializable.initializing: re-entrancy guard for initializer nesting
Ownable.initialize(address sender) public initializer: sets the owner
Ownable.transferOwnership(address) public onlyOwner: owner-gated ownership transfer
Ownable._transferOwnership(address) internal: writes _owner after zero-address check
Proxy._delegate(address) internal: raw delegatecall forwarder in assembly
Proxy._fallback() internal: entry to delegate fallback path for every unknown call
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._setImplementation(address): writes implementation slot, requires contract
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.changeAdmin(address) external ifAdmin: rotates proxy admin
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) payable ifAdmin: upgrades and delegatecalls arbitrary data
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._setAdmin(address) internal: writes admin slot
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback() internal: blocks admin from entering fallback
UpgradeabilityProxy constructor(address,bytes) payable: sets implementation and delegatecalls init data
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize(address,address,bytes) payable: sets implementation and admin on an uninitialized proxy
ERC20.transfer(address,uint256) public: external transfer entry point
ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint256) internal: moves balances
ERC20.approve(address,uint256) public: allowance entry point
ERC20._approve(address,address,uint256) internal: writes allowance mapping
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public: allowance-based transfer entry point
ERC20._mint(address,uint256) internal: increases total supply and balance
ERC20._burn(address,uint256) internal: decreases total supply and balance
ERC20WithPermit.permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,bool,uint8,bytes32,bytes32) external: signature-based approval
ERC20WithPermit.initialize(uint256,string,string,string,uint8) public initializer: builds EIP-712 domain separator
CanReclaimTokens.recoverTokens(address) external onlyOwner: owner can pull ETH or ERC20 out of the contract
CanReclaimTokens.blacklistRecoverableToken(address) public onlyOwner: marks a token non-recoverable
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn(IERC20,bytes) private: low-level call to an arbitrary token address
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256) internal: low-level value call to arbitrary recipient
Address.isContract(address) internal view: extcodehash-based contract detection gate
TornomyERC20.mint(address,uint256) public onlyOwner: privileged mint entry point
TornomyERC20.burn(address,uint256) public onlyOwner: privileged burn entry point
TornomyERC20.transfer(address,uint256) public: blocks transfers to the token contract itself
TornomyERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public: blocks transfers to the token contract itself
Claimable.claimOwnership() public onlyPendingOwner: completes two-step ownership handover
Claimable.transferOwnership(address) public onlyOwner: nominates a pending owner
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256) internal pure: overflow-checked addition
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) internal pure: underflow-checked subtraction
SafeERC20.safeTransfer(IERC20,address,uint256) internal: external token transfer wrapper
SafeERC20.safeApprove(IERC20,address,uint256) internal: external token approval wrapper
msg.sender: external caller identity used for access control, funding and admin checks
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenced time used by the permit expiry check
delegatecall(gas, implementation, ...) in Proxy._delegate executing arbitrary calldata in proxy storage
_logic.delegatecall(_data) in UpgradeabilityProxy constructor with attacker-influenceable init data
newImplementation.delegatecall(data) in upgradeToAndCall: admin-supplied delegatecall
recipient.call.value(amount)("") in Address.sendValue: unchecked low-level ETH call
address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn: arbitrary token low-level call
assembly sstore(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT, newImplementation): direct storage write of the logic address
assembly sstore(ADMIN_SLOT, newAdmin): direct storage write of the proxy admin
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) in recoverTokens: ETH push to an untrusted caller
nonces[holder]++ in permit: unchecked (wrapping) arithmetic increment
newOwner parameter of Ownable._transferOwnership: becomes the new owner
newImplementation parameter of _setImplementation: address written to IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT
newAdmin parameter of changeAdmin: address written to ADMIN_SLOT
data parameter of upgradeToAndCall: payload passed to delegatecall
holder parameter of permit: signer and allowance owner
nonce parameter of permit: checked against nonces[holder]
expiry parameter of permit: compared against block.timestamp
spender parameter of permit: address receiving the allowance
_token parameter of recoverTokens: token address or address(0) for ETH
recipient parameter of ERC20.transfer: destination of the transfer
amount parameter of ERC20._transfer: balance movement magnitude
sender parameter of ERC20._transfer: debited account
account parameter of ERC20._mint: credited account
_to parameter of TornomyERC20.mint: owner-specified mint target
_logic parameter of InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize: implementation address
local slot variable holding IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT before sstore/sload
local success flag returned by the delegatecall in upgradeToAndCall
local digest variable: EIP-712 hash passed to ecrecover in permit
local amount variable in permit: uint256(-1) or 0 based on the allowed flag
local newAllowance variable in SafeERC20 allowance helpers passed to approve
local returndata variable in callOptionalReturn decoded as bool
local size variable in Address.isContract holding extcodesize

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with _owner through the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership
ifAdmin modifier gates changeAdmin on msg.sender == _admin()
_willFallback reverts when msg.sender equals the proxy admin
recoverTokens is restricted to the owner identified from msg.sender
msg.sender becomes the recipient of the ETH balance pushed out in recoverTokens
any external msg.sender reaching the proxy enters _fallback
permit validates expiry against the miner-influenced block.timestamp (timestamp dependency)
permit executes the unchecked nonce increment used for replay protection
unchecked nonces[holder]++ mutates the stored nonce counter without overflow protection
Ownable.initialize writes the owner slot
initializer modifier sets the initialized flag
initializer modifier sets and clears the initializing flag
transferOwnership forwards to _transferOwnership
_transferOwnership assigns the new _owner value
claimOwnership calls _transferOwnership with the pending owner
claimOwnership deletes the pendingOwner slot
Claimable.transferOwnership stores the nominee in pendingOwner
_fallback routes execution to _delegate
_fallback invokes the _willFallback hook before delegating
_delegate performs the raw delegatecall operation
delegatecall runs arbitrary implementation code inside the proxy, which can re-enter the fallback
UpgradeabilityProxy constructor sets the initial implementation
constructor delegatecalls the provided initialization data
constructor-time delegatecall executes external logic during deployment in the proxy storage context
upgradeToAndCall first upgrades the implementation pointer
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls the admin-supplied data
admin data delegatecall executes untrusted code in the proxy context and can re-enter proxy functions
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin to persist the new admin
_setAdmin performs the sstore into ADMIN_SLOT
_setImplementation performs the sstore into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT
proxy initialize writes the admin slot
proxy initialize writes the implementation slot
ERC20.transfer delegates to _transfer
transferFrom moves balances through _transfer
transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve
approve writes the allowance through _approve
permit sets the allowance through _approve
permit reads and consumes the stored nonce
permit includes DOMAIN_SEPARATOR in the signed digest
ERC20WithPermit.initialize assigns DOMAIN_SEPARATOR
_transfer updates the balances mapping
_transfer relies on SafeMath.sub for the sender balance deduction
_transfer relies on SafeMath.add for the recipient balance credit
_approve updates the allowances mapping
_mint increases _totalSupply
_mint increases the credited balance
_burn decreases _totalSupply
_burn decreases the debited balance
recoverTokens consults the recoverable token blacklist
blacklistRecoverableToken writes the blacklist mapping
recoverTokens routes ERC20 balances through safeTransfer
recoverTokens pushes the ETH balance to msg.sender
safeTransfer delegates to callOptionalReturn
safeApprove delegates to callOptionalReturn
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level token call
the arbitrary token call can re-enter the approval wrapper before state settles
sendValue performs the low-level ETH value call
an untrusted recipient can re-enter sendValue during the value transfer
TornomyERC20.mint calls the internal _mint
TornomyERC20.burn calls the internal _burn
TornomyERC20.transfer forwards to the base ERC20.transfer
TornomyERC20.transferFrom forwards to the base ERC20.transferFrom
newOwner parameter flows into the owner assignment
newImplementation parameter is validated and stored as the logic address
newAdmin parameter flows into the admin rotation
data parameter is the payload handed to the delegatecall
holder parameter is hashed, recovered from the signature and approved
nonce parameter is compared with nonces[holder]
expiry parameter bounds the permit validity window
spender parameter receives the resulting allowance
_token parameter selects the blacklist check and the transfer target
recipient parameter is the transfer destination
amount parameter sizes the balance movement
sender parameter identifies the debited account
account parameter identifies the credited mint target
_to parameter is the privileged mint destination
_logic parameter becomes the proxy implementation on initialization
permit computes the EIP-712 digest local
permit derives the approved amount from the allowed flag
the derived amount is written as the allowance
_setImplementation loads IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT into the local slot variable
the local slot variable drives the assembly sstore
upgradeToAndCall stores the delegatecall result in the success local
safeApprove allowance helper computes the newAllowance local
callOptionalReturn captures the raw return bytes in returndata
Address.isContract stores extcodesize in the size local

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a pure input of _transferOwnership and carries no independent security semantics
newImplementation is only meaningful as the argument of the implementation-slot writer
newAdmin is only an argument of the admin rotation entry point
data is the raw calldata of the delegatecall, so it collapses into that unsafe operation
holder is consumed entirely inside the permit validation and approval flow
nonce is validated and consumed inside permit
expiry is only used for the permit timestamp check
spender is only used as the permit allowance beneficiary
_token selects the branch and transfer target inside recoverTokens only
recipient is a plain argument of the transfer entry point
amount is a plain scalar argument to the balance movement routine
sender is the debited account argument of _transfer
account is the credited argument of the mint routine
_to is the destination argument of the owner-gated mint
_logic is only used as the implementation argument of proxy initialize
the slot local exists only to feed the assembly sstore of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT
success exists only to check the delegatecall performed by upgradeToAndCall
digest is an internal intermediate hash inside permit
the permit amount local only feeds the allowance write
newAllowance is a transient computation of the approval wrapper
returndata only holds the result bytes of the low-level token call
size is a transient extcodesize value used only by the contract check
